catalog.query: SELECT technology, description, website, categories, groups, source, source_version, source_run_id, updated_at FROM corpscout.technology_catalog FINAL ORDER BY technology

review.method: Source quotations, current catalog names/metadata, and primary documentation; semantic judgments are explicit inputs, not automatic fuzzy matches.
review.candidate_generation: Top four case-folded name similarities plus explicitly reviewed related entries. Scores are retrieval signals, not identity confidence.

matching_policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace normalization; punctuation preserved
matching_policy.before_coverage: Catalog matching, including unique normalized matches; no aliases
matching_policy.after_coverage: The same catalog matching plus accepted aliases
